remarks: Full of character and thoughtfully updated, this 1917 Craftsman sits on a private corner lot in Santa Barbara's desirable Westside, just moments from local shops and amenities. A comprehensive renovation and primary suite addition by Becker Studios in 2017 brought a fresh, modern feel while honoring the home's original charm. The interior showcases quality materials and refined details, including wood floors, marble countertops, and a Bertazzoni range. The inviting primary suite features a walk-in closet, en-suite bath, and French doors that open to the outdoor living areas, creating a light-filled retreat with an easy indoor-outdoor connection.
